sentences.text:
Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Sharma
1. Exemption allowed, subject to just exceptions.

2.  The application is disposed of accordingly. W.P.(CRL) 1121/2023 & CRL.M.A. 10618/2023 (Delay in Re-filing)
3.

The present writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks quashing of FIR No. 330/2018 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Sabzi Mandi, Delhi and all other consequential proceedings emanating therefrom, including the chargesheet pending in the court of competent jurisdiction.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that vide Settlement Deed dated 09.06.2022,
petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 2 have settled their disputes.
6. Learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State accepts notice.
7. Issue notice to respondent no. 2 to be served through the SHO concerned, returnable on 14.08.2023.
